verdict.rationale: Exa is an API-first product. It documents public REST endpoints, for example `curl -X POST https://api.exa.ai/search` with an `x-api-key` header, and offers downloadable OpenAPI specs, official `exa-py`/`exa-js` SDKs, rate-limit docs, and APIs for Contents, Agent and Websets. A hands-on user confirmed driving the search API in an agentic chatbot. missing for 10: the OpenAPI spec is not served at standard discoverable paths (the probe got 404s), and one hands-on report found the Websets 'Get Code' cURL sample was broken.
